en: Colorized vintage view of a park fountain. In the center stands a large ornate multi-tiered fountain with water arcing outward in many streams. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll and sit around the basin, surrounded by manicured lawns, flower beds, large leafy plants, and tall trees. The sky is pale blue with light clouds. At the top left, printed text identifies the scene.
